title: 未来工厂：全集成、全自动
title_en: The future factory: fully integrated, fully automated

segments.zh: 这是一座未来工厂。订单一进来，整座工厂就自己动起来。
segments.en: This is a factory of the future. An order comes in, and the whole plant starts moving on its own.

segments.zh: 原料从立体仓库出库，每一箱都扫条码、扫二维码，无人车一路送到产线。
segments.en: Materials leave the automated warehouse, every tote scanned by barcode and QR code, and driverless carts carry them to the line.

segments.zh: 机械臂接手：上料、拧紧、装配，一台接一台。
segments.en: Robot arms take over: loading, fastening, assembling, one after another.

segments.zh: 每一件产品都要经过机器视觉质检站：拍照、测量、判定，一眨眼完成。
segments.en: Every product passes a machine-vision station: image, measure, decide, in the blink of an eye.

segments.zh: 不合格的，自动推出产线；合格的，自动生成 FDA 要求的 UDI 标签：二维码加人能读的文字，贴上、扫码复核、发货。
segments.en: Rejects are pushed off the line; good parts get an automatically generated FDA UDI label, a 2D code plus human-readable text, then a verifying scan, and they ship.

segments.zh: 所有设备的数据，都实时汇到同一个数据中枢。
segments.en: Data from every machine flows, live, into one data hub.

segments.zh: 放大看质检站。相机在上，环形灯打光，零件从下面流过。
segments.en: Zoom in on the inspection station. Camera above, ring light on, parts flowing underneath.

segments.zh: 系统先读零件上的二维码，知道它是哪一批；再把图像变成尺寸：孔径、孔距、划痕，一项项和图纸公差比。
segments.en: It first reads the 2D code on the part to know its lot, then turns the image into dimensions: hole size, spacing, scratches, each checked against the drawing.

segments.zh: 全部合格，亮绿灯放行；有一项超差，推杆把它推进隔离箱。
segments.en: All in tolerance: green light, pass. One out: a pusher sends it into the quarantine bin.

segments.zh: 每个测量值都画进控制图。趋势一偏，还没出废品，就先报警。
segments.en: Every reading goes onto a control chart. When the trend drifts, it alarms before a single bad part.

segments.zh: AI 起草不合格报告，但怎么处置，要工程师点头才生效。
segments.en: AI drafts the nonconformance report, but the disposition takes effect only when an engineer approves.

segments.zh: 质检站不只有相机。三坐标测量机；三维扫描仪装在五轴上：X、Y、Z 三个直线轴，加上扫描头摆动和转台旋转，联动扫完整个零件；还有粗糙度仪。测完的数据自动传回，不用抄。
segments.en: The inspection station is more than a camera. A coordinate measuring machine; a 3D scanner on five axes, X, Y and Z plus a tilting head and a rotary table, moving together to cover the whole part; and a roughness tester. Their results come back automatically. No copying by hand.

segments.zh: 游标卡尺、千分尺、专用量规，带无线发送：按一下，读数就进记录，对上是哪个零件、哪一项。
segments.en: Calipers, micrometers and custom gauges send wirelessly: one press, and the reading lands in the record, tied to the part and the feature.

segments.zh: 每个读数都记着用的是哪台量具。量具过了校准期，读数不收，提醒送检。
segments.en: Every reading records which gauge took it. If that gauge is past its calibration date, the reading is refused and the gauge is flagged for recalibration.

segments.zh: 所有读数汇成一张表，自动判合格，进控制图，再进数据中枢。
segments.en: All readings come together in one table, judged automatically, plotted on control charts, and sent on to the data hub.

segments.zh: 最后看中枢：订单、库存、设备、质量，连成一张数据网。
segments.en: Finally, the hub: orders, inventory, machines and quality, in one connected web of data.

segments.zh: 数字孪生把整座工厂实时画在屏幕上，哪里慢、哪里堵，一眼看到。
segments.en: A digital twin draws the whole plant live on screen: where it's slow, where it's jammed, at a glance.

segments.zh: 发现问题，AI 给出建议：换刀、降速、补料。
segments.en: When something's off, AI suggests a fix: change the tool, slow down, restock.

segments.zh: 人在关键处确认，机器人执行，结果再回到中枢，形成闭环。
segments.en: A person approves at the key step, robots carry it out, and the results flow back to the hub. A closed loop.

segments.zh: 全集成，全自动。人从搬运和盯守里解放出来，专心做判断。
segments.en: Fully integrated, fully automated. People are freed from hauling and watching, to focus on judgment.
